products.note: Network security AI; Zero Trust integration; autonomous threat response; critical infrastructure

profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NASDAQ: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site positions the company as serving security professionals including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, with offerings spanning network security, cloud workload protection, hybrid workforce security, threat intelligence, and security consulting. The company describes its approach as built around Zero Trust architecture and powered by artificial intelligence.

The company's tracked AI product is Palo Alto Networks Precision AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI, with noted capabilities in network security, Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response, and critical infrastructure protection. The site also references the Strata network security platform, described as proactively monitoring, analyzing, and preventing threats in real time, and an AI-driven SecOps platform the company characterizes as the top-ranked platform of its kind, powered by unified data, artificial intelligence, and automation. Additionally, the site introduces Idira, described as a next-generation identity security platform intended to secure every identity for AI enterprise environments.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
